name: Lutz
source:
"Hey. Try asking me 'are you happy?'"

Cheerful, but also a bit selfish and gets lonely easily. He has a lovable personality, and people find it hard to leave him alone. He used to be a general citizen of Stahl. He was the youngest child in the family, having an older brother and sister above him, but he lost his family during the war. He gets along with everyone easily, and he's the mood maker of the group.
